faqs.question: What is the minimum order quantity (MOQ) and unit price for Custom Double-Sided 3D Souvenir City Keychains?

faqs.question: What is the mold or tooling fee for Custom Double-Sided 3D Souvenir City Keychains, and when is it waived?
faqs.answer: Tooling policy for Custom Double-Sided 3D Souvenir City Keychains is $110 Two-Sided 3D Mold. Every client receives custom steel tooling cut strictly to their artwork, stored free of charge for 3 years in our Zhongshan mold vault so subsequent reorders pay $0 mold fees.

faqs.question: What base materials and manufacturing crafts are used on Custom Double-Sided 3D Souvenir City Keychains?
